families.title: Positioning & Acoustics
families.description: Technologies used to establish, monitor and communicate position references between vessel, subsea systems and assets.

families.title: Surface Navigation
families.description: Vessel-side references for position, heading and motion that every subsea measurement is tied to.

families.title: Subsea Navigation & Inertial
families.description: Sensors that keep the ROV localized between acoustic fixes: inertial, velocity, depth and sound velocity.

families.title: Hydrography & Imaging
families.description: Acoustic sensors that map the seabed and image what lies on and beneath it.

families.title: Inspection & Pipeline
families.description: Tools to locate, measure and assess the condition of pipelines and subsea structures.

families.title: Data Acquisition & Software
families.description: Navigation, acquisition, recording and processing stack that turns sensor data into deliverables.

families.title: Online Survey & Network
families.description: Online survey room hardware: computers, servers, network switches, serial servers, UPS and internet links.

families.title: Communications & Telemetry
families.description: Radio, Wi-Fi and video telemetry links plus remote helmsman displays for the bridge and ROV control.

families.title: ROV Interface
families.description: Multiplexers, instrument rack, umbilical fibre and camera feeds that carry survey data between the ROV and topside.

equipment.title: C-NAV GNSS
equipment.whatIsIt: A GNSS receiver using C-Nav satellite-delivered corrections for high-accuracy vessel positioning.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Gives the vessel the global position that every subsea position reference is tied to.

equipment.title: GNSS Correction Service
equipment.whatIsIt: A correction service broadcast by satellite to the vessel's GNSS receiver.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Improves raw GNSS accuracy so vessel positions meet survey specifications.

equipment.title: Mini Beacons
equipment.whatIsIt: Small acoustic transponders deployed on the seabed, structures or vehicles.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Reply to acoustic interrogations so their position can be tracked or used as a reference.

equipment.title: LBL Navigation Transceiver
equipment.whatIsIt: A long baseline acoustic navigation transceiver establishing precise subsea position references.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Exchanges ranges with seabed beacons to localize an ROV against the Survey frame.

equipment.title: Compatt
equipment.whatIsIt: A seabed LBL transponder that forms the fixed reference array of a long baseline system.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Measures baselines between array nodes and answers ROV transceiver interrogations.

equipment.title: USBL Transceiver
equipment.whatIsIt: A hull or pole mounted ultra-short baseline transceiver.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Tracks beacons on ROVs, structures and seabed targets relative to the vessel.

equipment.title: Gyrocompass
equipment.whatIsIt: A heading sensor referenced to true north.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Orients the vessel frame so acoustic and GNSS positions are rotated correctly.

equipment.title: Surface MRU / INS
equipment.whatIsIt: A motion reference unit or inertial system installed on the vessel.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Compensates acoustic and hydrographic measurements for vessel motion.

equipment.title: Subsea Heading & Motion Sensor
equipment.whatIsIt: An ROV-mounted inertial sensor providing heading, attitude and motion.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Keeps the ROV navigated smoothly between acoustic position updates.

equipment.title: Doppler Velocity Log
equipment.whatIsIt: An acoustic sensor that measures ROV velocity relative to the seabed.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Aids the inertial solution so position drift stays low between fixes.

equipment.title: Bathymetric Sensor
equipment.whatIsIt: A high-accuracy pressure / altitude sensor mounted on the ROV.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Provides the vertical reference for ROV positioning and seabed profiles.

equipment.title: Sound Velocity Profiler
equipment.summary: Sound velocity through the water column.
equipment.whatIsIt: A probe that measures sound velocity with depth.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Corrects acoustic ranges and multibeam soundings for water column refraction.

equipment.title: Multibeam Echosounder
equipment.whatIsIt: A swath sonar that measures many depths across the track at once.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Produces high-density seabed terrain models and as-built surveys.

equipment.title: Side Scan Sonar
equipment.whatIsIt: A towed or ROV-mounted sonar that images the seabed on both sides of the track.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Detects debris, pipelines and seabed features.

equipment.title: Sub-bottom Profiler
equipment.whatIsIt: A low-frequency sonar penetrating the upper seabed layers.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Reveals burial depth and shallow soil layering along a route.

equipment.title: Pipe Tracker
equipment.whatIsIt: An ROV-mounted electromagnetic detection system.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Measures the position and depth of cover of buried pipelines and cables.

equipment.title: CP Probe
equipment.whatIsIt: A probe used by the ROV to take cathodic protection potential readings.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Assesses the corrosion protection status of pipelines and structures.

equipment.title: Subsea Laser Scanner
equipment.whatIsIt: An ROV-mounted laser that captures dense 3D point clouds.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Supports metrology, as-built and dimensional control of subsea assets.

equipment.title: EIVA NaviPac
equipment.whatIsIt: Navigation software that integrates GNSS, heading, motion and acoustic inputs.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Computes and displays vessel and ROV positions in real time.

equipment.title: EIVA NaviScan / NaviEdit / NaviModel
equipment.whatIsIt: Software suite for sensor data acquisition, cleaning and terrain modelling.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Turns raw survey data into charts, models and client deliverables.

equipment.title: Video Recorder & Overlay
equipment.summary: Records ROV video with survey overlay.
equipment.whatIsIt: Digital video recording system with navigation data overlay.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Captures eventing video for inspection and survey reporting.

equipment.title: RAID Video Storage
equipment.whatIsIt: Redundant disk storage for video and survey data offshore.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Protects project data until it is delivered onshore.

equipment.title: Survey Computers & Monitors
equipment.whatIsIt: Rack or desk workstations with displays for online survey.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Hosts navigation, acquisition and QC software for the survey crew.

equipment.title: Online Master PC
equipment.whatIsIt: The main online survey workstation in the survey room.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Runs online navigation, takes every sensor feed from the network and drives the helmsman displays.

equipment.title: Online Backup PC
equipment.summary: Hot backup for the online master.
equipment.whatIsIt: A second online workstation mirroring the master PC configuration.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Takes over online navigation if the master PC fails, so operations are not interrupted.

equipment.title: Naviscan / MBES PC
equipment.whatIsIt: Workstation dedicated to multibeam acquisition and QC.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Logs R2Sonic multibeam data and feeds the online survey monitors.

equipment.title: OMS PC
equipment.whatIsIt: Workstation on the survey network with its own internet access.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Handles reporting and office tasks without loading the online navigation PCs.

equipment.title: Server
equipment.whatIsIt: Rack server on the survey network, paired with the RAID.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Stores and shares project data between the online and processing workstations.

equipment.title: Printer
equipment.summary: Network printer for logs and reports.
equipment.whatIsIt: Network printer in the online survey room.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Prints daily reports, logs and field documentation.

equipment.title: Network Switch
equipment.whatIsIt: Managed Ethernet switch. The full spread uses three: #1 survey room hub, #2 bridge, #3 ROV control.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Connects PCs, serial servers, sensors and remote displays into one survey network.

equipment.title: MOXA NPort Serial Server
equipment.summary: Brings serial sensors onto the network.
equipment.whatIsIt: Serial device server. The full spread uses three: #1 survey room, #2 bridge, #3 ROV control.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Converts RS-232/422 sensor strings (GNSS, gyro, MRU, radio) into network data for the online PCs.

equipment.title: APC UPS
equipment.summary: Uninterruptible power for the online spread.
equipment.whatIsIt: UPS units protecting the online survey rack.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Keeps online navigation running through vessel power dips and blackouts.

equipment.title: Internet Access Connection
equipment.summary: Vessel internet drops for the survey spread.
equipment.whatIsIt: Internet connection points supplied to the survey room.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Gives the online and OMS PCs access to correction services, email and data transfer.

equipment.title: Survey Online Monitors
equipment.whatIsIt: Five displays in the survey online room for navigation, MBES and ROV video.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Shows the online picture, MBES data and camera feeds to the survey crew.

equipment.title: Online Survey System
equipment.summary: Integration of the full online survey spread.
equipment.whatIsIt: System-level line covering set-up, integration and commissioning of the online survey spread.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Brings PCs, network, sensors and displays together as one working online system.

equipment.title: C-Nav X1 Receiver
equipment.summary: Dual GNSS receivers with C-Nav corrections.
equipment.whatIsIt: C-Nav X1 GNSS receiver; the full spread runs two for redundancy.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Delivers corrected vessel position and the PPS/ZDA timing signal to the online system.

equipment.title: C-Nav X1 Antenna
equipment.summary: GNSS antenna for the C-Nav X1.
equipment.whatIsIt: Mast-mounted GNSS antenna, one per C-Nav X1 receiver.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Receives GNSS signals and satellite-delivered C-Nav corrections.

equipment.title: C-Nav X1 Iridium Edge Antenna
equipment.whatIsIt: Iridium Edge antenna paired with each C-Nav X1 receiver.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Provides an alternative correction delivery path via the Iridium network.

equipment.title: USBL Topside Unit
equipment.summary: Topside processor of the USBL system.
equipment.whatIsIt: Topside unit of the Ranger 2 USBL system in the survey room.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Drives the subsea head and outputs acoustic positions to the online network.

equipment.title: Ranger 2 USBL Subsea Head (HPT 5000)
equipment.summary: USBL transceiver head on a side pole or through the moonpool.
equipment.whatIsIt: The Ranger 2 USBL subsea head — an HPT 5000 transceiver — deployed on a side pole or through the moonpool.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Measures range and bearing to the ROV and to the C-Node beacons, giving their position relative to the vessel.

equipment.title: C-Node
equipment.whatIsIt: Acoustic transponders used as positioning references; the full spread uses three.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Answer acoustic interrogations so ROV and structures can be positioned.

equipment.title: Hemisphere VS1000 Antenna
equipment.whatIsIt: Pair of GNSS antennas (AFT and FWD) feeding the VS1000 heading receiver.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: The baseline between the two antennas gives a GNSS-derived heading.

equipment.title: Hemisphere VS1000 Receiver
equipment.whatIsIt: Hemisphere VS1000 dual-antenna GNSS receiver.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Provides secondary position and GNSS heading to the online system.

equipment.title: Gyro Octans 9
equipment.whatIsIt: Fibre-optic gyrocompass and motion reference supplied with the survey spread.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Gives heading, roll, pitch and heave to the online system.

equipment.title: PPS/ZDA Splitter Box
equipment.whatIsIt: Splitter box for the PPS pulse and ZDA time message from the C-Nav receiver.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Keeps every acquisition computer synchronized to GNSS time.

equipment.title: Gyro (Vessel Supplied)
equipment.summary: Vessel gyro feed taken on the bridge.
equipment.whatIsIt: The vessel's own gyrocompass output, supplied by the vessel.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Provides an independent heading for QC against the survey gyro.

equipment.title: MRU (Vessel Data)
equipment.whatIsIt: Motion reference unit output taken from the vessel systems on the bridge.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Provides vessel roll, pitch and heave to the survey network.

equipment.title: DGPS (Vessel Data)
equipment.whatIsIt: Differential GPS output taken from the vessel systems on the bridge.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Provides an independent vessel position for QC.

equipment.title: HiPAP / APOS Interface
equipment.whatIsIt: Interface to the vessel's HiPAP acoustic positioning system (APOS).
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Brings vessel acoustic positions into the survey network for QC and redundancy.

equipment.title: Barometer
equipment.whatIsIt: Topside barometer on the ROV control network.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Provides atmospheric pressure to correct ROV depth from pressure sensors.

equipment.title: Gyro (ROV)
equipment.whatIsIt: Gyrocompass installed on the ROV.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Gives ROV heading and attitude through the subsea MUX.

equipment.title: Altimeter
equipment.whatIsIt: Acoustic altimeter on the ROV.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Measures ROV altitude above the seabed.

equipment.title: Mini SVS
equipment.whatIsIt: Compact sound velocity sensor fitted on the ROV.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Feeds real-time sound velocity to the multibeam for beam steering.

equipment.title: DQ (Digiquartz Depth Sensor)
equipment.whatIsIt: Digiquartz precision pressure sensor fitted on the ROV.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Gives precise ROV depth, corrected with the topside barometer.

equipment.title: SVX2 Sound Velocity Sensor
equipment.whatIsIt: SVX2 sound velocity sensor fitted on the ROV, wired separately from the DQ.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Measures sound velocity for the acoustic and multibeam corrections.

equipment.title: R2Sonic MBES Heads
equipment.whatIsIt: Pair of R2Sonic multibeam heads mounted on the ROV (SPD007 / SPD008).
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Collects swath bathymetry under the ROV.

equipment.title: R2Sonic SIM
equipment.whatIsIt: Topside sonar interface module of the R2Sonic multibeam.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Links the multibeam heads to the Naviscan / MBES PC and distributes time and motion.

equipment.title: TSS 440 Topside Unit
equipment.summary: Topside of the TSS 440 pipe tracker.
equipment.whatIsIt: Topside processor/display of the TSS 440 pipe and cable tracker.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Processes the coil signals and outputs target position and depth of burial.

equipment.title: TSS 440 Bottle
equipment.whatIsIt: Subsea electronics bottle of the TSS 440 mounted on the ROV.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Drives the search coils and sends their readings up through the subsea MUX.

equipment.title: TSS 440 Coils
equipment.summary: Search coils on the ROV front.
equipment.whatIsIt: Search coil array of the TSS 440 mounted across the ROV.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Detects buried pipelines and cables by electromagnetic induction.

equipment.title: Green Laser
equipment.whatIsIt: Green laser fitted to the ROV and interfaced through the subsea MUX.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Provides an optical reference for visual measurement and alignment tasks.

equipment.title: Satel Radio
equipment.whatIsIt: Satel UHF radio modem in the survey room.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Exchanges position/correction data with other vessels or stations over radio.

equipment.title: Satel Radio Antenna
equipment.whatIsIt: Mast-mounted UHF antenna.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Transmits and receives the Satel radio link.

equipment.title: Bullet WiFi Antenna
equipment.whatIsIt: Outdoor Wi-Fi radio/antenna on the mast.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Provides a wireless network link to the survey network.

equipment.title: Bullet PoE Box
equipment.whatIsIt: PoE injector feeding the Bullet antenna.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Powers the antenna and bridges it into network switch #1.

equipment.title: Video Telemetry TX Unit
equipment.whatIsIt: Video telemetry transmitter unit.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Sends ROV camera feeds over a radio link.

equipment.title: Video Telemetry RX Unit
equipment.whatIsIt: Video telemetry receiver unit.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Receives video over the radio link and puts it on the online monitors.

equipment.title: Video Telemetry TX Antenna
equipment.whatIsIt: Mast antenna of the video telemetry transmitter.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Radiates the video telemetry link.

equipment.title: Video Telemetry RX Antenna
equipment.whatIsIt: Mast antenna of the video telemetry receiver.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Picks up the video telemetry link.

equipment.title: Bridge Remote Helmsman
equipment.whatIsIt: Remote helmsman display installed on the bridge via switch #2.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Shows the bridge team the vessel and ROV positions against the planned line.

equipment.title: ROV Remote Helmsman
equipment.summary: Survey display for the ROV pilots.
equipment.whatIsIt: Remote helmsman display in ROV control via switch #3.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Shows the ROV pilots their position, heading and targets.

equipment.title: Video Telemetry System
equipment.summary: Integration of the video telemetry link.
equipment.whatIsIt: System-level line covering set-up and commissioning of the video telemetry link.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Delivers ROV video over radio to the online monitors.

equipment.title: INNOVA Topside MUX
equipment.summary: Topside end of the ROV fibre multiplexer.
equipment.whatIsIt: Topside multiplexer in the survey online room that de-multiplexes survey data coming up the ROV fibre.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Puts subsea sensor data onto the survey network, the R2Sonic SIM and the ROV instrument rack (SD061).

equipment.title: INNOVA Subsea MUX
equipment.summary: Subsea hub for all ROV survey sensors.
equipment.whatIsIt: Subsea multiplexer on the ROV.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Collects every ROV survey sensor (gyro, MBES, DQ, TSS, cameras) and sends it up the fibre.

equipment.title: ROV Instrument Rack (Fibre Connection)
equipment.summary: Survey interface and fibre connection rack in ROV control.
equipment.whatIsIt: Rack in the ROV control room where the survey signals meet the ROV system and the umbilical fibre is terminated.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Patches survey data between the topside MUX (SD061), MOXA #3 (SD058 / SD059) and the ROV fibre in the umbilical.

equipment.title: ROV Fibre in Umbilical
equipment.summary: Fibre allocated to survey in the ROV umbilical.
equipment.whatIsIt: Optical fibre in the ROV umbilical/tether reserved for survey data.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Carries the multiplexed survey data between the subsea and topside MUX.

equipment.title: ROV Camera Feeds
equipment.summary: ROV video channels into the survey spread.
equipment.whatIsIt: Video channels from the ROV cameras made available to survey.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Feeds the online monitors, video recording and video telemetry.

equipment.title: Booms Cameras
equipment.summary: Three cameras on the ROV booms.
equipment.whatIsIt: Three cameras mounted on the ROV booms (SPD033–SPD035), wired into the ROV video system (SD087–SD089).
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Give side and forward views of the target during inspection; their video reaches topside as ROV camera feeds.

equipment.title: USBL System (Complete)
equipment.whatIsIt: System-level line covering the complete USBL system: topside, subsea head, cabling and calibration.
equipment.whatDoesItDo: Positions the ROV and seabed targets from the vessel.

systems.title: Survey - Surface Navigation
systems.description: Everything the vessel needs to know where it is: GNSS, motion, navigation software and recording.

systems.title: Survey - Subsea Positioning
systems.description: Acoustic references that tie ROVs, structures and seabed targets to the vessel frame.

systems.title: Survey - Vessel References
systems.description: Heading and motion references installed on the vessel.

systems.title: Survey - ROV Navigation
systems.description: Aided inertial navigation keeping the ROV localized between acoustic fixes.

systems.title: Survey - Hydrographic Mapping
systems.description: Swath bathymetry, imagery and sub-bottom data for route and as-built surveys.

systems.title: Survey - Pipeline Inspection
systems.description: Locate, measure and assess pipelines and subsea structures.

systems.title: Survey - Data Acquisition & Processing
systems.description: Online navigation, acquisition, recording and processing stack.

systems.title: Survey - Online Survey System
systems.description: Survey room spread: online PCs, network switches, serial servers, GNSS, heading and the links to the bridge and ROV control.

systems.title: Survey - USBL System
systems.description: Ranger 2 USBL: topside unit in the survey online room and the HPT 5000 subsea head on a side pole or moonpool, tracking the ROV and the C-Node beacons.

systems.title: Survey - Video Telemetry
systems.description: ROV camera feeds sent over radio and shown on the online monitors.

spreads.title: Full Survey Spread
spreads.description: Complete vessel + ROV survey spread from one-line diagram 803038098 rev A, organised by the rooms of the drawing: mast area, survey online, bridge, ROV control room, subsea and ROV.

zones.title: Mast Area
zones.description: Up on the mast, the C-Nav X1 and Iridium Edge antennas bring satellite positioning and corrections, the Hemisphere AFT/FWD pair gives GNSS heading, and the Satel, Wi-Fi and video telemetry antennas link the vessel to the outside world.

zones.title: Survey Online
zones.description: The survey online room is the brain of the spread: GNSS receivers, MOXA #1 and Network Switch #1 gather every sensor, the online PCs compute positions, and the INNOVA topside MUX brings the ROV data in from the umbilical.

zones.title: Bridge
zones.description: On the bridge the vessel supplies its own Gyro, MRU, DGPS and HiPAP/APOS data through MOXA #2 and Network Switch #2, and the Bridge Remote Helmsman shows the survey picture to the officers.

zones.title: ROV Control Room
zones.description: In the ROV control room, Network Switch #3 and MOXA #3 feed the ROV Remote Helmsman and the barometer, while the instrument rack patches the survey data into the ROV fibre in the umbilical.

zones.title: Subsea
zones.description: Under the hull, the Ranger 2 USBL subsea head — the HPT 5000, on a side pole or through the moonpool — tracks the ROV and the C-Node beacons acoustically and reports to the USBL topside unit over SPD001.

zones.title: ROV
zones.description: On the ROV, the INNOVA subsea MUX collects the gyro, altimeter, DQ, SVX2, Mini SVS, green laser, both R2Sonic heads and the TSS 440, while the three booms cameras feed the ROV video and the C-Node beacons answer the USBL.

zones.title: Integration & Systems
zones.description: System-level BID lines for set-up, integration and commissioning. They are part of the scope but are not physical equipment, so they are not shown in 3D.

pipeline.title: TSS 440 Topside Processing
pipeline.description: Turns the coil readings into target position and depth of burial before they reach navigation.

pipeline.title: NaviPac Online Navigation
pipeline.description: Combines position, heading, motion, depth and acoustic fixes into the real-time navigation solution and logs it.

pipeline.title: NaviScan MBES Acquisition
pipeline.description: Logs the multibeam swaths with sound velocity, motion and heading applied in real time.

pipeline.title: Video Recording & Overlay
pipeline.description: Records the ROV camera channels with the survey data overlay and events.

pipeline.title: Project Data Storage
pipeline.description: Server and RAID keep raw navigation logs, MBES files and video until processing and delivery.

pipeline.title: NaviEdit Navigation & Sensor QC
pipeline.description: Cleans and quality-checks navigation and sensor data offline.

pipeline.title: NaviModel Gridding & Charting
pipeline.description: Builds the seabed terrain model, contours and charts from the cleaned soundings.

pipeline.title: Video Review & Eventing
pipeline.description: Reviews the recorded video and logs inspection events and anomalies.

pipeline.title: Calibration Reports
pipeline.description: USBL CASIUS, MBES patch test and gyro calibration.
